stage1.impression: A coherent, warm, low-key night room with a believable one-point perspective down a long bar, and it has real mood. But it reads as a soft CG proof, not a photograph. A uniform haze veil flattens everything. The surfaces are smeared and stucco-like at 1:1, so there is no board-forming, no fir checks and no steel sheen. The pendants are flat white glowing cylinders, and the frosted screen on the right reads as a bright lightbox with a dark smudge. The hero speakers at the far end are two small pinkish slivers hidden behind lounge chairs, set against a near-white gallery-bright alcove that steals the eye.

blocking_9: The Ember speaker reads at a glance as the hero: a full silhouette unobstructed by the chairs, saturated red (r_median at least 1.8x g_median in its region), and clearly the most saturated thing in frame
The listening-room alcove reads as seen through smoked acrylic, darker than the speaker and not a white gallery (alcove wall median below the speaker median)
Pools of light from the pendants land on the fir bar top, and the bar top region median rises to about 40-60 with a visible falloff between pools
The haze veil is reduced so the blacks hold depth (frame lum_p1 around 3-5) while the shadows keep their detail
At delivered resolution and 1:1, the concrete shows formwork grain and tie holes, the fir shows checks and darker end grain, and the steel shows an uneven sheen; no denoiser smear on walls or floor
The frosted screen glows softly at about 2x the surrounding wall, not 3.5x, and its image reads as a hand or shell in fog, not a stain
The pendants show diffuse frosted acrylic with a warm 2400 K glow and polished edge highlights, not flat clipped white cutouts
Signs of life: a record out of its sleeve, a coat on the banquette, a half-drunk glass in a light pool

defects.what: Ember speaker (left) almost entirely hidden behind a lounge chair, reads as a pink sliver; r176/g119/b101 is washed, not Ember red
Second Ember speaker also mostly hidden behind a chair; the card wants one of the pair to read, and neither does
The listening-room alcove walls are near-white and the brightest large area in frame (median 124); the smoked partition does not read at all, so it looks like an open doorway to a gallery
Frosted screen at median 108.6, about 3.5x the wall around it, near-neutral grey (r119 g106 b100); reads as a lightbox, and the shell image reads as a dark stain or ghost
Pendant tube flat and clipped (1.32% clip, median 158), cooler than the room (r176 g154 b140); looks like an unlit emissive cylinder pasted in, with no frosted depth or edge glow
Second pendant, the same flat white cutout; a thin vertical rod appears to run from it down to the bar near x 205 (reads as a pole or an intersection)
Bar top dark (median 23.8) with no pendant pools; the pendants' light does not land on the bar
Folded menus on the bar glow bright white like phones or tablets
Fog speaker niche: a lit slot with a small white blob; the Fog speaker is not legible as an object
A global haze veil lifts the blacks (lum_p1 7.3) and flattens contrast; the room reads foggy rather than atmospheric
Floor speckled and smeared (denoiser or sample noise), with no clean polished reflection of the alcove
Right-hand concrete wall reads as mottled stucco with no formwork grain, tie holes or pour lines
Foreground stools and bar front a near-uniform dark brown mass (median 15.5); stool tops have no rim highlight, and the fluted bar front is soft
Fir beams uniform and soft, with no checks, nail holes or end-grain darkening
